quality.basis: 第五类无法转化成有效任务：触发需要单次追加超过 2 GiB 输出（约需 10 GB 内存、关掉 libFuzzer 限额），标准判定服务做不到

ground_truth_evidence: category 5: none: the overflow needs the printer to append >= 2 GiB of output in one go, which takes a ~1.25 GB input, libFuzzer limits disabled and about 10 GB of RAM per run (and json_tokener_parse_ex rejects lengths above INT32_MAX), none of which a standard task server provides; the dataset's 2.3 GB input OOMs libFuzzer on both builds.

review.note: a 2.3 GB input; libFuzzer runs out of memory reading it on both builds (the dataset's own report: 'Vulnerability not triggered')

category5.design: The injected code drops the `size > INT_MAX - p->bpos - 1` guard in printbuf_memappend, so a single append that makes bpos+size overflow int memcpy's past the buffer. It is reachable only with >= 2 GiB of printed output in one append, which a standard task server cannot afford, so there is no usable PoV; the spec keeps the harness and marks the task unusable.
